description: This file contains unit tests for the web-search module, specifically testing functions related to date normalization, freshness filtering, unsupported filter responses, and scoped configuration merging.

methods.name: buildUnsupportedSearchFilterResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response indicating an unsupported search filter, with specific handling for country and date filters.

methods.name: isoToPerplexityDate
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string to a Perplexity format (MM/DD/YYYY).

methods.name: normalizeToIsoDate
methods.description: Normalizes various date formats to ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD).

methods.name: normalizeFreshness
methods.description: Normalizes freshness filter values based on the search provider (Brave or Perplexity).

methods.name: mergeScopedSearchConfig
methods.description: Merges plugin-specific search configuration into a broader search config, optionally mirroring API keys.
